name: @odaclick/skill-verify-with-mcp-before-commit
description: Use AFTER any UI/UX change and BEFORE git commit. The main agent drives Playwright (admin/web) or Maestro/mobile-mcp (Expo) via text interfaces and dispatches the eyes subagent at checkpoints to capture + describe (visual-evidence contract); evidence in .logs/evidence/<date>/<task-id>/; refuses to commit if MCP can't reach the running app.
